resources.string: Draw a secret word, pass the device and guess. No drawing skills needed.
Two to eight people take turns drawing a secret word while the others guess. Pass the device around the table.
The drawer\'s team does the guessing. Needs an even table of four or more.
Everyone draws once in every round.
How long the drawer has. The clock stops while someone is guessing.
Take your time. Faster guesses still score a little more.
Players guess by picking a picture card or by typing the word.
Six picture cards and no typing. Best for younger players.
Type your guess. Best for readers and writers.
